2.23.29
Tablix.ReportSlicerState
Applies to RDL 2011/01
The Tablix.ReportSlicerState element specifies the filter state for a Tablix that filters data for other
report items. The Tablix.ReportSlicerState element is optional and MUST NOT be specified more
than once. This element is defined in [MS-RDLRS] section 2.31.
